verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent explicitly supports multi-step, iterative investigation (effort levels, source-pulling, iterate until satisfied, artifact generation) and the Systematic Reviews workflow chains search→screening→extraction→reporting, well beyond a single-pass summary. Community feedback (e.g. elicit-comm-3/4/5) raises accuracy/hallucination concerns but does not contradict the multi-step architecture itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the agent autonomously executes multi-step plans without heavy user steering, and more detail on how effort levels translate into deeper investigation.
